title: submit_material_graph specification
description: Apply edited inspect_material graphs[] / parameters to an existing material or create under scratch roots (WS-08). Prefer in-place for production. Never silent-delete user masters. fidelity.round_trip_supported remains false until retrieve→replace→retrieve is proven. Owned by WS-08.

graphs.description: ADR-0004 MaterialGraph documents from inspect_material result.graphs. Agents may edit before submit. Required unless parameters is provided for MIC-only updates.

parameters.description: MIC (or master default) parameter overrides. Prefer this for MaterialInstanceConstant edits. Values are current desired values, not named keys alone.

apply.description: Optional knobs; defaults favour safe in-place edits.

links.description: Reconnect expression links that reference existing node_ids (masters only).

property_inputs.description: Apply extensions.material.property_inputs MP_* wiring when nodes exist.

create_missing_expressions.description: When true and target is under scratch roots, create nodes listed in graphs that are missing. Never enabled silently on production.

delete_missing_expressions.description: When true with envelope mode=replace AND scratch root only, delete expressions absent from graphs. Forbidden on production masters.

parent_material.description: Optional parent master path when creating a new MaterialInstanceConstant under scratch roots.
